meta.purpose: Test whether ContradictionChecker can verify an assistant claim against a tool-trace entry. The component prompts a cross-encoder reranker with an explicit SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS instruction and labels CONTRADICTS below a 0.6 threshold, so the question is not whether it asks the right question but whether a relevance-trained reranker can answer it.
meta.prior_art: NevIR (Weller, Lawrie & Van Durme, EACL 2024) ranks two documents differing only by negation and finds most IR models perform the same as or worse than random; cross-encoders are the best architecture and land just above random. ExcluIR extends this to exclusionary queries. This experiment is the equivalent test on structured tool results rather than prose documents.

groups.A: claim agrees with the trace entry -> SUPPORTS
groups.B: claim contradicts the trace entry, same vocabulary and same object -> CONTRADICTS
groups.C: claim and trace entry are unrelated -> NO_EVIDENCE, which the component cannot express because it only has two labels

failure_modes_in_B.opposite_state: the claim asserts the state the trace denies (open vs closed, active vs revoked)
failure_modes_in_B.action_failed: the tool call errored, bounced or was rejected and the claim reports success
failure_modes_in_B.wrong_value: same field, different value (amount, time, version, replica count)
failure_modes_in_B.denies_own_action: the claim denies an action the trace shows was executed
failure_modes_in_B.opposite_count: the claim asserts zero or one against a different count

formats.openai: OpenAI chat-completions shape: an assistant message with tool_calls plus the tool-role result message
formats.otel: OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions execute_tool span attributes (gen_ai.tool.name, gen_ai.tool.call.arguments, gen_ai.tool.call.result)
formats.prose: a natural-language log line, the shape a framework prints to stdout

meta.why_formats_matter: The reranker scores surface text, so the rendering of the trace is an experimental variable, not a presentation detail. A finding that only holds for one rendering is a finding about that rendering. Each case is stored structurally and rendered by render.py, so the same cases run under all five formats.
meta.first_run_finding: At 120 cases the score did separate A from B (AUC 0.88-0.92), refuting the stronger hypothesis that the component carries no signal. The failure was structured instead: lexical opposites were caught almost always, while action_failed (10-40%) and wrong_value (25-62%) mostly passed as SUPPORTS. Group C was labelled CONTRADICTS 40/40 in every format at a mean score near 0.001, confirming the component cannot distinguish absence of evidence from contradiction. This expansion raises each failure mode from 5-10 cases to 32 so the per-mode rates can be reported as measurements rather than indications.
